QuestInfo.name: Zelya's Map
QuestInfo.0: The cave fairy #b#p701##k in the #m10006000# has been watching me since I arrived. She seems to have a request.
QuestInfo.1: #b#p701##k, a cave fairy in the #m10006000#, told me about how her people once lived deep, deep inside the cave. She longs to return to her old home, but she was attacked by #o54#s while out on a walk and dropped the map she'd drawn to find her way back. The monsters may have already torn it to pieces, but if I defeat the #r#o54#s#k east of #b#m10006000##k and gather the fragments, she might be able to figure something out.
QuestInfo.2: As the cave fairy #b#p701##k requested, I defeated the monsters and brought back the fragments of the map of the route to her original home. Hopefully some clues can still be found within them...

0.0: Oh... you're the human #b#p702##k keeps talking about. I didn't believe him. A surface-dweller who came all the way down here on purpose? You must have remarkable courage.
0.1: Yes... Somehow, I feel I can trust you. We cave fairies once lived much deeper within the #m10006000#, but after that sorrowful incident long ago, we had no choice but to leave our home.
0.2: Still, I believe I can return one day. That's why I drew a map when I left, so I would never forget the way home. But a few days ago, while walking around to refresh my memory, I was attacked by #o54#s and dropped my precious map.
0.3: I can't share everything with someone I've just met... but please, I beg you. Could you recover my map? The monsters may have already torn it apart, but even the fragments might hold clues.

yes.0: Thank you so much! The monsters that attacked me were #r#o54#s#k. They dwell in the eastern parts of the #m10006000#. Please defeat them and bring back the map fragments.

no.0: So, #p700# was right after all... humans really are selfish...

1.0: I knew I could count on you to help. Now I can show #p700# that not all humans are selfish--that some really are righteous. Thank you, from the bottom of my heart!
1.1: Now I have to piece these fragments together, one by one. It'll take some time, but if it leads me back home, I will endure anything.

item.0: Please defeat #r#o54#s#k dwelling east of the village and bring back the map fragments. I'm counting on you.
